title: UX-01: hosted run, Director review declined (D29) and design audit with Impeccable
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Hosted run 39848720360 on pull request #7 (pull_request event) at 26b8f4e8b3495ace0b0d2ef63ee2b1aa611a061c concluded success: design-system job 2026-10-22T20:25:30Z to 20:34:33Z, foundation job 2026-10-22T20:25:30Z to 20:36:22Z. Public job metadata only; logs and artifacts were not downloaded.

Decision D29: the Director declined visual approval of the UX-01 reference screens (functional errors; lack of quality and uniqueness; generic stylization and requirements not followed; plain layouts in places and structure copied from the legacy app elsewhere) and instructed the agent to locate a tool that can hold it accountable for UX design, similar to Impeccable, and to audit the design and its own work. Recorded in docs/vision/decision_register.csv.

Design audit of 26b8f4e (docs/audits/2026-10-23-ux-01-design-audit.md): Impeccable engine v0.1.16 (Apache-2.0; linux-x64 binary SHA-256 a890a5b4b7d9d79ec54aa74612b5e924e5f5b422600a25fde8bcbda11b031787, matching the published checksum; run on the host with telemetry off) detector over 63 reference stories at four viewport and theme combinations, and its critique procedure run in a single context because sub-agents are not authorized; Hallmark static gates (MIT, 7ec8682); two Playwright functional walks in the dev container. Verdict: design specificity fails; compositions follow the legacy app; twelve functional defects (four P1); heuristics 23/40. Outputs stay in the ignored .local/ux-01-audit/.

Two statements in the task 9 review against the section 33 criteria (CHG-20261022-013, docs/validation/ux-design-system.md) are wrong and are corrected by appended text: 'Legacy composition copied: none' (the deckbuilder, top bar, Collection and match compositions follow the legacy app) and 'every control acts within its story' (match Play only announces, every Challenge is rejected, inkwell placement is never available). The audit supersedes that review.

Status lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md, the UX-01 backlog status, the design and implementation plan status lines, the design-system validation and HANDOFF.md record the hosted run, D29 and the audit; the audit is classified as evidence in docs/documentation-map.json.
